name: 21325-smallbatchdecode-70b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (one a3 node, --gres=gpu:4), NVLink within the node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one node, one in-process engine.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM, 80 layers, hidden 8192, 64 query / 8 KV heads, bf16; 70.6B params = 141 GB, 35.3 GB per GPU at TP4. Rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, bounded at 1000 requests / 3600 s safety, warmup the first 5% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, `request_format: plain` (raw completion string, no chat template). Prompt exactly 1024 tokens, output exactly 128 -- the backend sets `ignore_eos=True` whenever `max_tokens` is set. No per-request sampling parameters, so engine defaults stand; `spec.seed` 21325 seeds the data generator.
purpose: A 70B text completion service handling 1024-token prompts with 128-token replies for 16 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 35366ae57c8d18a33fb5d12baf95c29dd86bd075
# (v0.10.0rc1-49-g35366ae57c). The interpreter, extra wheels and the hardware seal are in
# configs/env.yaml, which is per-machine and not portable.

model: unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# V1 turns prefix caching ON by default at this commit, so this line is load-bearing: the
# workload is random synthetic text with no shared prefix.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# MUST BE ONE LINE. The reader is flat and skips any line starting with a space, so rewriting
# this as a nested block drops the key silently and the engine starts without it.
compilation-config: {"level": 3, "custom_ops": ["+rms_norm"], "pass_config": {"enable_fi_allreduce_fusion": true}}
